settings.rate.label: Rate
settings.rate.description: Clicks or key presses per second (or minute, depending on the unit).
settings.rate_unit.label: Rate unit
settings.rate_unit.description: Whether the rate is measured per second or per minute.
settings.action.label: Action
settings.action.description: What to repeat while the clicker is running.
settings.custom_key.label: Custom key
settings.custom_key.description: A single key or chord, for example space, enter, or ctrl+shift+a.
settings.hold_ms.label: Button hold
settings.hold_ms.description: How long the button or key stays down on each press. To keep every click visible to games that read input once per frame, at least half the interval (up to 20 ms) is used automatically.
settings.jitter_pct.label: Timing jitter
settings.jitter_pct.description: Random variation in each interval, as a percentage. Zero is perfectly regular.
settings.start_delay.label: Start delay
settings.start_delay.description: Countdown before clicking starts, so you can switch to the game window.
settings.max_duration.label: Maximum duration
settings.max_duration.description: Stop automatically after this many seconds. Zero means run until stopped.
settings.target_app.label: Target window
settings.target_app.description: Optional class or title substring. The clicker only runs while that window is focused.
settings.stop_on_focus_loss.label: Stop on focus loss
settings.stop_on_focus_loss.description: Stop when the focused window no longer matches the target window.
settings.show_osd.label: Show OSD
settings.show_osd.description: Show a small on-screen popup when the clicker starts or stops.
settings.notify.label: Notifications
settings.notify.description: Show notifications for errors and macro completion.
settings.helper_path.label: Helper binary
settings.helper_path.description: Path to clickerd. Run clicker/helper/install.sh to build and install it.
settings.macro_default_repeat.label: Default macro repeat
settings.macro_default_repeat.descriptio: Repeat count for newly created macros. Zero loops until stopped.
settings.macro_default_loop_delay.label: Default loop delay
settings.macro_default_loop_delay.descri: Delay between macro repeats, in milliseconds.
settings.macro_max_runtime.label: Macro runtime cap
settings.macro_max_runtime.description: Safety cap for macros that loop forever, in seconds. Zero uses the macro's own value.
settings.fisher_target_app.label: Terraria Fisher target window
settings.fisher_target_app.description: Window class or title the Terraria Fisher only runs in. Terraria's Steam class is steam_app_105600.
settings.fisher_cast_button.label: Cast button
settings.fisher_cast_button.description: Mouse button that casts and reels. Terraria uses its Use / Attack button, left click by default.
settings.fisher_press_ms.label: Cast press length
settings.fisher_press_ms.description: How long the button stays down for each cast or reel, in milliseconds.
settings.fisher_settle_ms.label: Cast settle time
settings.fisher_settle_ms.description: How long to ignore audio after casting, so the bobber landing is not mistaken for a bite.
settings.fisher_bite_timeout.label: Bite timeout
settings.fisher_bite_timeout.description: Recast when no bite is heard after this many seconds.
settings.fisher_reel_delay_ms.label: Reel delay
settings.fisher_reel_delay_ms.descriptio: Wait this many milliseconds after a bite before reeling in. The default 33 ms is about two frames at 60 FPS; raise it if the reel sometimes happens too early.
settings.fisher_post_reel_ms.label: Pause after reeling
settings.fisher_post_reel_ms.description: Time between reeling in a catch and the next cast, in milliseconds.
settings.fisher_recover_ms.label: Pause after a miss
settings.fisher_recover_ms.description: Time between reeling in an empty line and recasting, in milliseconds.
settings.fisher_max_casts.label: Cast limit
settings.fisher_max_casts.description: Stop after this many casts. Zero means fish until stopped.
settings.fisher_max_runtime.label: Terraria Fisher time limit
settings.fisher_max_runtime.description: Stop after this many seconds. Zero means no time limit.
settings.fisher_sensitivity.label: Detection sensitivity
settings.fisher_sensitivity.description: How closely audio must match the bite sound, from 0.1 (eager) to 0.99 (strict). Real bites score around 0.75, so 0.70 is a good start.
settings.fisher_min_interval.label: Minimum bite interval
settings.fisher_min_interval.description: Ignore further matches for this many milliseconds, so one bite cannot reel twice.
settings.fisher_audio_device.label: Audio device
settings.fisher_audio_device.description: PulseAudio source to listen to. Empty means the default speaker's monitor.
settings.fisher_template.label: Bite sound file
settings.fisher_template.description: Optional Splash_5.xnb (or another .xnb) or raw f32 template. Empty finds Terraria automatically.
settings.fisher_pitch_variants.label: Pitch tolerance
settings.fisher_pitch_variants.descripti: Also match slightly pitch-shifted copies of the bite sound. Keep on unless detection is noisy.
settings.widget.hide_when_idle.label: Hide when idle
settings.widget.hide_when_idle.descripti: Only show the bar widget while the clicker or a macro is active.
settings.widget.show_rate.label: Show rate
settings.widget.show_rate.description: Show the current rate next to the widget glyph.
